steps.en: Add the skill (Node 22.2+ and ffmpeg) or install the desktop app
steps.zh: 加技能（Node 22.2+ 与 ffmpeg）或装桌面应用

steps.en: Ask your coding agent for a film in plain words
steps.zh: 用一句话向编程 agent 要一条片子

steps.en: Prints the manual and opens the film folder in local Studio
steps.zh: 打印说明书，在本地 Studio 打开影片目录

steps.en: The agent writes film.html and shot pages, then checks frames with look
steps.zh: agent 写 film.html 与镜头页，再用 look 查帧

steps.en: Watch it land live; retype, move, trim or restyle anything by hand
steps.zh: 实时看改动落地；亲手改字、挪位、剪辑或换样式

steps.en: Keeps your edits as overrides and merges them over the agent's next write
steps.zh: 把手改存为 overrides，合并在 agent 下次重写之上
在 film.html 旁渲染出 MP4

value.en: A film you and the agent both edit, without re-prompting for each small fix or losing hand edits
value.zh: 片子你和 agent 都能改，小修不用重新提示，手改也不会被冲掉
